run_generate_personas_cli: run the CLI to generate diverse personas with characteristics and memories using a specified generator and LLM model
run_generate_personas_with_alphaevolve: run the persona generator CLI with an alphaevolve variant generator to produce diverse synthetic personas
run_create_language_model: run the language model setup function to create a Concordia language model from a given API type and model name
run_generate_persona_characteristics: run the two-stage generator to produce diverse persona characteristics using specified diversity axes and initial context
run_generate_persona_memories: run the generator to create formative memories for a single persona based on its characteristics
